subject: a tall stack of three thick, fluffy buttermilk pancakes topped with whipped cream marbled with a swirl of smooth sweet red bean paste, a spoonful of whole sweet red beans, and a thin drizzle of honey

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The top face of each pancake is griddle-browned in a soft, blotchy, uneven gradient — warm caramel brown (#B9793F) at the centre where it sat longest on the hot pan, fading through toasty golden (#CF9455) into light golden (#D9A76B) toward the rim, with a few slightly darker freckles and one paler patch where a bubble lifted the batter, the way real pancakes never brown evenly. The side wall of every pancake is the pale cream of the risen crumb (#F1DDB0): a soft, spongy band with a fine open crumb texture, tiny irregular air pockets catching the light, meeting the browned top in a soft blurred edge rather than a hard line. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: CREAM AND RED BEAN SWIRL
toppings.text: A generous mound of lightly whipped cream (#FFF8EC) sits slightly off-centre on the top pancake, and a spoonful of smooth sweet red bean paste (#5E2A2A) has been folded once through it with the back of a spoon, so the white and the deep plum-brown marble together in loose, uneven ribbons — thick in one place, thin in another, broken where the spoon lifted — rather than a neat spiral. The cream keeps its soft rounded peaks and matte velvety surface; the paste is smooth and moist with a faint sheen, and where the two meet the edges blur into soft pink-brown streaks.

toppings.label: WHOLE BEANS
toppings.text: On top and down one side of the mound, a spoonful of whole sweet red beans (#7A3F3A) — about ten of them, each a plump rounded bean with a split, slightly wrinkled skin, glossy with their own dark syrup, at different angles and sizes: a cluster of five or six sitting in the cream, three sliding down its side onto the browned pancake, one alone near the rim leaving a small dark syrup smear behind it.

toppings.label: HONEY
toppings.text: A thin drizzle of clear golden honey (#D9A441), translucent and glossy, traced once across the cream and the beans and spilling over the front edge of the top pancake into two slow drips of different lengths down the pale side walls, turning the crumb it touches a darker soaked gold and catching a bright highlight along each drip.

toppings.label: FINISHING
toppings.text: A light haze of powdered sugar over the bare rim of the top pancake and the outer folds of the cream, dissolving into faint specks where it meets the honey. Two halves of a toasted walnut (#A9784A), their ridged surfaces catching the light, tucked against the base of the cream at different angles. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.

Soft studio softbox key light from the upper left with gentle warm ambient fill, a subtle rim of light along the top edges of the stack, and a faint, soft contact shadow directly beneath the stack only. notes_ko: v5(2026-09-02): 리서치(med) — 스택형은 팥+생크림(생크림단팥빵 공식), 도라야키 샌드와는 다른 플레이팅. "swirl" 정체성은 반죽 속 리본이 아니라 크림에 한 번 접은 앙금 마블로 옮김(완벽 나선 회피). 통팥 낱알 보이게. 견과는 리서치 garnish에서.
